name: Long Function Analysis
description: Pseudo-C-first analysis workflow for large functions (>200 instructions) where disassembly cannot fit in a single tool call. Exports full analysis packages (disasm + decomp + C↔assembly mapping) to the workspace.

files.description: Complete workflow: export, read pseudo-C, verify against assembly, fix variables, reconstruct

angr template: reconstruct a switch jump table and enumerate all cases
